needs.what: The frame rate the game was tested at is not applied (nxnative writes the engine's frame limit or steps the game by the host's vsyncs); the game runs at its own rate.
GPU timestamp reports are not per segment: a game that measures its GPU time may pick a wrong dynamic resolution.
Textures the game fills in place from the CPU and publishes with a pool flush are not uploaded: some textures may be missing or stale.
Textures the game rewrites in memory without telling NVN are not uploaded again (needs write tracking of guest pages).

This game does not fit a 32-bit memory: the profile reserves heap 8.00 GB, alias 4.00 GB, stack 0.25 GB with a pool of 9.00 GB; this process has heap 3.31 GB, alias 0.25 GB, stack 0.06 GB: the pool is larger than a 32-bit address space can hold; the game runs until it needs more (a 64-bit memory would be needed).
